## EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.operandOptions property

Single option letters (without a sign) that take a name or value operand under both `-` and `+`<!-- -->, e.g. `['o']` for `-o pipefail` / `+o pipefail`<!-- -->. A letter listed here never selects the command string itself, so `bash -o c script` keeps `c` as an option \*name\*. The selector `c` is reserved and cannot be listed as an operand option; conflicting entries throw [ShAnalyzeInvalidWrapperSpecError](./sh-analysis.shanalyzeinvalidwrapperspecerror.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly operandOptions: readonly string[];
```
